title: Alpenzoo Innsbruck-Tirol
highlights: Höchstgelegener Themenzoo Europas auf 750 Metern Meereshöhe am Hang der Nordkette
Über 2000 alpine Wildtiere aus 150 verschiedenen Arten in naturnahen Gehegen
Spektakuläre Freiflugvolieren, Bären- und Wölfe-Gehege sowie Alpen-Aquarium
Bequem erreichbar direkt mit der futuristischen Hungerburgbahn ab Innsbruck-Zentrum
kurzbeschreibung: As Europe's highest themed zoo, Alpenzoo Innsbruck showcases over 2,000 alpine animals in a natural setting on the slopes of the Nordkette.
beschreibung:
Biodiversity of the Alpine Habitat

On the sunny slope of the Nordkette lies the Alpenzoo Innsbruck-Tirol, the only themed zoo in the world dedicated entirely to alpine wildlife. Brown bears, wolves, lynxes, ibexes, and majestic bearded vultures can be observed here at close range.

Cold-Water Aquarium and Show Farm

A highlight is the world's largest cold-water aquarium featuring rare alpine fish species. At the traditional show farm, young visitors get to know endangered alpine domestic animal breeds such as Tiroler Grauvieh or Brillenschafe.
